```yaml
name: Community Tests (No Secrets)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - dev
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  code_quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Validate lockfile
        run: pip-compile --check requirements.in

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        run: pre-commit run --all-files

      - name: Run Ruff check and format
        run: ruff . && black .

  unit_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    strategy:
      matrix:
        test-file: [
          'tests/unit/test_graph_logic.py',
          'tests/unit/test_text_chunking.py',
          'tests/unit/test_retrieval.py',
          'tests/unit/test_search.py',
          'tests/unit/test_pipelines.py',
          'tests/unit/test_visualization.py',
          'tests/unit/test_ontology.py',
          'tests/unit/test_permissions.py',
          'tests/unit/test_cache.py',
          'tests/unit/test_session.py',
          'tests/unit/test_config.py',
          'tests/unit/test_cli.py',
          'tests/unit/test_telemetry.py'
        ]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run specific unit test file
        run: pytest ${{ matrix.test-file }}

  cli_unit_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    strategy:
      matrix:
        test-file: [
          'tests/cli/test_cli_command1.py',
          'tests/cli/test_cli_command2.py',
          'tests/cli/test_cli_command3.py',
          'tests/cli/test_cli_command4.py',
          'tests/cli/test_cli_command5.py'
        ]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run specific CLI test file
        run: pytest ${{ matrix.test-file }}

  telemetry_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run telemetry test
        run: pytest tests/unit/test_telemetry.py

  aggregate_results:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [code_quality, unit_tests, cli_unit_tests, telemetry_test]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Aggregate test results
        run: |
          echo "::group::Test Results"
          cat $(find . -name '*.xml' | xargs grep -E 'failures="0" errors="0"')
          echo "::endgroup::"

      - name: Check for failures
        id: check_failures
        run: |
          if find . -name '*.xml' | xargs grep -qE 'failures="[1-9]"|errors="[1-9]"'; then
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Fail workflow if any test failed
        if: ${{ steps.check_failures.outputs.exit_code == 1 }}
        run: echo "One or more tests failed."
        env:
          GITHUB_STATUS: failure
```
